observations: Photo 0: Black Yamaha keyboard, full-size keys, labeled 'YAMAHA Professional' at top left; model text is tiny and partly cut off, not legible.
Photo 1: Same keyboard laid flat, showing keys slightly yellowed, panel buttons and sliders visible; a watermark 'MARY OLUGBAMI' overlays much of the branding area.
Photo 2: Close-up of control panel showing 'YAMAHA PortaSound' text and 'Auto Bass Chord' feature; model number again obscured by watermark/angle.
No power cord, adapter, stand, or display screen (on/off) is visible in any photo.
No evidence of the keyboard being powered on or producing sound.
Visible wear: yellowing of white keys, scuffed casing, worn paint on edges, suggesting significant age/use.

claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: No power-on test or sound demonstration shown; visible cosmetic wear (yellowed keys, scuffed body) is not consistent with 'quality and good' claim, but functional state cannot be confirmed either way from static photos.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or may have dead keys/buttons.
risks.proof: Video clip of the seller powering it on and pressing several keys across the range, including any demo/voice buttons.

risks.risk: Missing power adapter required to operate the unit.
risks.proof: Photo of the included adapter/cord with the keyboard.

risks.risk: Sliders, pitch control, or speakers may be faulty (common on old PortaSound units).
risks.proof: Video showing sliders being moved and audio coming through speakers.

risks.risk: Exact model unknown, so true specs (number of keys, voices, memory) can't be confirmed.
risks.proof: Clear, unobstructed close-up photo of the model number plate (usually near keys or on the back).
risks.if_unproven: priced as base low-end PortaSound/PSS type keyboard

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model number plate without watermark obstruction.
Video of the keyboard powering on and playing a few notes/demo song.
Photo showing the power adapter and any accessories included.
response.reason: Brand Yamaha is visible but the exact model is unreadable due to watermark and angle, and no proof of working condition is given, so it must be priced at worst case as a basic, unverified-working Yamaha keyboard, matching the cheapest comparable listings for similar generic Yamaha keyboards in the market.
